summary: Maren Ellery, a verified customer on secure chat, asked whether her replacement card was being made and had been sent. The desk queried the card system about it and closed the case in the asked state, but no card status came back. The reply to her and the escalation note were both refused, so she has not been told the production or dispatch status, and someone still needs to check the replacement record and tell her. No changes were made to her account.
